definition: After a winning trade, increase the next trade's size; after a loser, cut it back.
boundaries: Known failure: the biggest size meets the loss that ends the streak, so one loss can take back the run's gains; it pays only when wins cluster. Named so a unit, a source or he can point at it; its maths is the risk session's.
recognition: Size grows while the trades keep winning and shrinks after a loss.

sources.quote: increase their position size after profitable trades and reduce it after losses
exposes him to a single large loss that may wipe out previous gains
